title: Add rd_spy_overbought + rd_warning_count regime features
description: Current regime: SPY RSI=82.0, 3 warnings. Historical analyst is flagging overbought conditions. These regime signals are in rd_ml_bridge_signals.json but not fed to the model.
proposed_fix: Add 'rd_spy_overbought' and 'rd_warning_count' to FEATURE_COLS in feature_engineer.py. Read from rd_ml_bridge_signals.json['regime'] in _get_rd_features(ticker). These are ticker-independent (market-wide) features.

title: Label and study 6 never-seen winners
description: Top-20 performers absent from all pipelines: ['MRVL', 'VRT', 'RKLB', 'NUE', 'TSM', 'C']. Add these as positive examples to the label set and check which model features they share — the model can learn the profile of winners our watchlists structurally exclude.

title: Add sector RSI as per-ticker ML feature
description: Average sector RSI across tracked tickers: 65.2. Sector-level RSI captures sector rotation momentum not in individual ticker RSI. R&D already computes this — just needs routing to feature_engineer.
proposed_fix: Add 'rd_sector_rsi' and 'rd_sector_bullish' to FEATURE_COLS. Read from rd_ml_bridge_signals.json['tickers'][ticker]['rd_sector_rsi']. Default 50 (neutral) when ticker not in bridge.
